blocking.section: Decision outcome (rules table, row State Store); Consequences (Upstream-scoped bullet); More information (Open questions bullet)
blocking.issue: This is a new regression from the L1-1 revision. The State Store row presents the upstream replay rule as settled Plugin ABI v1 behavior, and the table's lead-in says the rules follow the owning [Contract]. The owning document has no such rule. Its State Store rule reads 'One blocking call per Plugin Policy per request before commit ... a second returns `ERR_BUDGET`', so under the owning document the second attempt's call returns `ERR_BUDGET`, which is sticky (`RZ-PLG-006`). The ADR instead replays the first result. The row also cites OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20 as if it already existed, but the owning document's Open questions table ends at OQ-wasm-plugin-system-19. Only More information admits that the question is merely 'Proposed to the owning document'. An accepted ADR that freezes a rule its owning document contradicts, and cites an Open question ID that does not resolve, fails the requirement that the ADR agree with its owning document. The replay design itself is consistent with pack section 8.7 rule 1 and is not in dispute. Only its status is wrong.
blocking.evidence: L44: "Rules, Planned (M2) unless tagged, per the owning [Contract](../architecture/05-wasm-plugin-system.md#contract):". L55: "in upstream-leg Phases later attempts and steps replay the first result for the same Host Function and key without a round trip, parallel steps serializing (OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20)". L155: "Proposed to the owning document: OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20". Owning document, Host Function rules: "**State Store.** One blocking call per Plugin Policy per request before commit (pack section 8.7), in chain order; a second returns `ERR_BUDGET`." Its Open questions table ends at "OQ-wasm-plugin-system-19".
blocking.fix: Preferred fix, outside this file: the owning document adds OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20 to its Open questions, with options (a) replay and (b) forbid `state.*` at Upstream scope, and adds the replay clause to its State Store rule. Until that happens, mark the clause in this ADR as a proposal. This costs 3 net words and keeps the body within 1,500. In L55, replace "in upstream-leg Phases later attempts and steps replay the first result for the same Host Function and key without a round trip, parallel steps serializing (OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20)" with "in upstream-leg Phases, as proposed in OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20, later attempts and steps replay the first result for the same Host Function and key without a round trip, parallel steps serializing". Leave the More information sentence unchanged. It already records the proposal and both options.

non_blocking.suggestion: L112 "gets a parked bound of 12" should use the owning document's term. The Sizing table gives "parked bound 14" for the same 64 MiB Plugin at N = 16, R = 2, and 12 is the *guaranteed* parked bound, N - ceil(N/4), which the audit threshold of 16 uses. Write "has a guaranteed parked bound of 12". This adds one word, so offset it elsewhere.

non_blocking.section: Decision outcome (row proxy-wasm, Planned (M4)) vs Consequences (last bullet)
non_blocking.suggestion: The row fixes the fault radius: "a trap fails every context pinned to that instance". The Consequences bullet says "recycling and fault radius open (OQ-wasm-plugin-system-17)". Both follow from the owning document: rule 8 discards a faulted instance, and state lives in guest memory. Consider "with recycling and narrowing the fault radius open" so the two do not read as contradicting each other.

Option (b), "forbid `state.*` at Upstream scope (RZ-CFG-020)", stretches RZ-CFG-020 beyond its registered meaning: "Policy type or Plugin Phases not allowed at the scope" (Configuration model). A Capability-based scope ban would extend that code. Say "(extending RZ-CFG-020)" when OQ-wasm-plugin-system-20 is added to the owning document.

The verifier counts 1,493 body words against the 1,500 maximum. Any further edit must be net-neutral. The L2-1 fix above adds 3 words. Do not recover space by deleting text that resolved earlier findings (L1-1 to L1-3, earlier L2-1 to L2-3).

The roadmap has no M2 item for the PDKs and no M4 items for the proxy-wasm adapter yet. The tags match the owning document and the pack, so this is a roadmap gap, not an ADR defect. Flag it to the roadmap author.
